section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'Hypotheses', outlines four main predictions. These hypotheses concern the relationships between the RSES, Self-Liking, Self-Competence, and SDE, as well as the distinct Big Five trait profiles for these constructs. Specifically, it hypothesizes stronger associations of Conscientiousness and Openness with Self-Competence, and Emotional Stability with self-deception scales (SDE and Self-Liking).
